sentences.en: You are too clever not to solve the hard problem.
sentences.zh: 你太聪明了，不可能解决不了这个难题。

sentences.en: It is said that nobody has solved the problem yet.
sentences.zh: 据说至今没有人能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Hastily acquired knowledge was not enough to solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 仓促学来的知识不足以解决问题。
